Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (Windows packages only)
Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.

Shipped files: the Visual C++ runtime DLLs that the bundled OIDN DLLs import,
in oidn/bin (currently msvcp140.dll, vcruntime140.dll and vcruntime140_1.dll).
They are unmodified copies from Visual Studio 2022's Microsoft.VC143.CRT
redistributable folder (VC\Redist\MSVC\<version>\x64), installed app-local next
to the DLLs that use them. vork.exe and the Slang compiler link the C runtime
statically and do not use these files.

Terms: these files are "Distributable Code" under the Microsoft Visual Studio
license terms and are listed in Visual Studio's redistribution list:
  https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/
  https://learn.microsoft.com/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution
Those terms permit copying and distributing them in object code form with a
program that adds significant primary functionality. Recipients and
redistributors may not modify them, may not use Microsoft's trademarks to name
or endorse their programs, and may only redistribute them under terms that
protect them at least as much as Microsoft's licence terms. They are not
covered by vork's MIT/Apache-2.0 licence.

Updates: Microsoft services the system-wide Visual C++ Redistributable through
Windows Update; these app-local copies update when vork is updated.
